title: Composition of unary polynomial-time functions
statement: Let $\ell$ map bit strings to natural numbers, and let $f$ map bit strings to bit strings. If the unary word function $y\mapsto 1^{\ell(y)}$ is polynomial-time computable and $f$ is polynomial-time computable, then $y\mapsto 1^{\ell(f(y))}$ is polynomial-time computable.
